why: Drops the MINE_LAYER gate, so the mine cue keys on raw capacity again. Brown and Green carry a capacity of 2 and no MINE_LAYER, and the simulation refuses every mine from them (world.ts, ai/index.ts), so `deck`, `riser` and `both` would draw a 0.3 block and `crown` the shipped turret on two tanks that cannot lay a mine -- the failure PR #830 named -- and the drawn roster would fall from six groups to four, brown reading as grey and green as teal (issue #1059).
